body.statement: For the graph with deterministic \(X\to M\to Y\), uncertain \(X\to Y\) of probability \(q\in[0,1]\), and uncertain \(X\leftrightarrow Y\) of probability \(r\in[0,1]\), \(\mathcal O_{XY}=\{\{X\to Y,X\leftrightarrow Y\}\}\), \(R_{XY}=1-qr\), \(\partial R_{XY}/\partial q=-r\), and \(\partial R_{XY}/\partial r=-q\), including on the boundary of the square.
body.justification: This reduction recovers the familiar bow obstruction and checks the sign and normalization of the reliability gradient.
body.gap: It is a required special-case reduction, not an independent novelty claim.
body.consumer: It supplies a transparent unit test for any implementation of enumeration and exact differentiation.
